evidence.reason: The drain loop computes self.args.drain_deadline_s at line 998 but calls self.controller.drain_check(self.effects, liveness) without passing the remaining time, and reads the clock only after that call returns. A single scan can therefore run past the deadline before the fail-stop check, so the configured drain deadline does not bound the work. Threading the remaining deadline into the scan and capping probes is a routine correctness fix that preserves the existing fail-stop behavior.
